query:
SELECT sc.id, sc.value, sc.due_date, sc.status, sc.amount_paid, sc.asaas_payment_id, sc.subscription_id
FROM subscription_charges sc
INNER JOIN subscriptions s ON sc.subscription_id = s.id
INNER JOIN allowed_clients ac ON s.client_id = ac.id
WHERE ac.name LIKE '%Lucas%'
  AND sc.value BETWEEN 900 AND 1000
  AND sc.due_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
ORDER BY sc.due_date;
